principles.name: Cryptographic Byte Integrity vs Regulatory Authenticity
principles.description: Every ingested artifact must preserve original bytes and a SHA-256 hash. A matching hash confirms artifact integrity, but external authenticity requires official exchange origin (verified domain, digital signature, or licensed feed contract).

principles.name: Decimal Arithmetic and Rounding Standard
principles.description: All factor calculations must use exact fixed-point decimal arithmetic (NUMERIC(18, 8) for factors, NUMERIC(18, 4) for prices). Single-precision or double-precision IEEE-754 floats are strictly prohibited to prevent +0.0002 drift.

principles.name: Consumer Isolation and Semantic Separation
principles.description: Nominal tradable execution prices (v_nominal_execution_prices) must be strictly isolated from split-adjusted (ca.v_active_split_factors) and total-return series (ca.v_active_total_return_factors). Total-return prices must never be used for order fills.

principles.name: Tax-Cost Allocation Non-Price Invariant
principles.description: Demerger tax cost allocations (Section 49(2C) Income Tax Act) are tax-basis allocations, not price adjustment factors. Must be marked price_factor_applicable=false.

principles.name: No Synthetic Pre-Listing Bars
principles.description: Successor or renamed entities begin trading only on their official listing dates. Historical bars must never be backfilled or synthesized from predecessor trading history.

principles.name: Quarantine Fail-Closed Protection
principles.description: Historical bars remain quarantined (NULL adjusted_close) until all historical corporate actions for that instrument are authenticated against primary exchange evidence.

ingestion_workflow: Step 1: Retrieve original publication artifact from authorized exchange source.
Step 2: Store raw byte payload in corporate_action_source_artifacts with SHA-256 checksum.
Step 3: Parse and normalize corporate actions into corporate_action_events.
Step 4: Compute adjustment factors using fixed-point arithmetic in corporate_action_adjustment_factors.
Step 5: Execute security trigger verification checks (trg_ca_event_verification_guard, trg_ca_factor_guard).
Step 6: Update affected OHLCV daily bars only through authorized migration / security definer procedures.
